accountConnections.title: Account connections
accountConnections.vaultIntro: Vault entries expose metadata only. Experts can request a reference use; secret values never enter chat. Each delivery requires your approval.
accountConnections.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this account and its references? Vendor vault items are preserved.
accountConnections.onepasswordHelp: Use your own service account with access to only the required vaults. Official op CLI is required. Token is encrypted at rest; leave blank to keep the current token.
accountConnections.bitwardenHelp: Official bw CLI is required. After creating this connection, log in and unlock using its displayed isolated profile directory, then provide that session’s BW_SESSION. Octop does not log in for you or read the default personal vault.
accountConnections.bitwardenUnlockHelp: Enter BW_SESSION for this connection’s isolated profile. Kept in server memory for one hour only; restart, disconnect or forget clears it. Never enter your master password.
accountConnections.hostsHelp: One exact hostname per line, such as api.example.com. No wildcards. Only public HTTPS targets; empty denies delivery.
accountConnections.approvalIntro: Review each request’s purpose, target and operation here. Approval allows one exact action and never authorizes future requests.
accountConnections.approveHelp: The secret is injected only into the reviewed header. Redirects are not followed. Only HTTP status is returned; response content is discarded. Failures or restarts never replay delivery.
accountConnections.oauthIntro: For services without dynamic registration, register your own OAuth client. Provider approval, scopes and workspace permissions still apply. Other products’ client identities are never reused.
accountConnections.callback: Register this callback with the provider
accountConnections.removeOauthConfirm: Remove this account’s saved OAuth application?
accountConnections.oauthNext: After saving, return to the connector catalog and start authorization. Your application must be accepted and your account authorized before use.
accountConnections.name: Name
accountConnections.prefix: Secret prefix (for example, Bearer followed by a space)
